run_generate_tensor_parallel: run the script to generate a response from gpt-oss-120b using tensor parallelism
run_generate_20b_model: run the script to generate a response from gpt-oss-20b using auto device mapping
run_apply_chat_template: run the tokenizer to apply a chat template to a list of messages without tokenizing
run_generate_with_config: run model generation with a GenerationConfig specifying max_new_tokens and sampling
run_decode_response: run the tokenizer to decode model outputs into a human-readable response string
